answer_1.quote: We evaluate ParaICL extensively on several task categories, including reasoning, natural language inference (NLI), and coding.
answer_1.outputs: Answers to reasoning questions, solutions to math problems, logical continuations of events, and Python code

answer_2.quote: ParaICL consistently outperforms baseline methods on all datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method. On reasoning tasks, the average improvements with Llama-2-7B-Chat are 1.2%, 2.7%, and 2.0% for 3-shot, 9-shot, and 15-shot settings, respectively.
